verdict.rationale: Ollama exposes a documented REST API (ollama-gh-4) with base URLs, curl examples, and Python/JS libraries (ollama-docs-9,10,11,19), plus OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API surfaces (ollama-docs-12,13) enabling programmatic driving of the product for AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: a formal machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe shows 404s at standard OpenAPI paths) and independent third-party corroboration of API completeness.
